0.description: [Pending Launcher Update] Added 'High Precision NamePlates' option in Esc -> Interface -> NamePlates. This option disables an optimization only Ascension NamePlates and ElvUI currently take advantage of. Enabling this option will remove the 'laggy' feeling of NamePlates, but may significantly reduce your framerate in many scenarios.
